Commentary.Commentary: Right then! It would take Sri Lanka some time to sink in with this loss. They put up a real good fight and nearly gave the Indians a run for their money but in the end failed to capitalize on the platform that was set. The pressure now stays firmly on them as another loss would see the series go away from their hands. Can they keep the Men in Blue at bay? Or will Kohli and co. seal the deal in the third ODI? Join us on 27th August, 2017 at 1430 local (0900 GMT) to find out. Until then, it's goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Virat Kohli says that it was an exciting game of cricket which gave them a good test. Informs seeing two 100-run stands in a 237-run chase was quite bizarre but felt good to come through. Mentions that he doesn't regret experimenting with the batting order. Backs it by informing they were sent to slog but got out to good deliveries. Praises Akila Dananjaya for mixing it up well and outfoxing the Indian batsmen.

Upul Tharanga is really disappointed to not have cross the finish line. Rues the fact that they failed to create further in-roads after having an upper hand. Credits Dhoni and Bhuvneshwar Kumar for playing so well and taking their side through. Ends up saying he is really proud of his boys and gives a special credit to his bowlers and fielders and lauds the effort of Siriwardana and Kapugedera for putting up runs on the board.

Man of the Match, Akila Dananjaya says that the variation was working quite well for him and hence he made full use of it. Adds that he had his wedding yesterday and reached the hotel late at night. Ends by saying he is happy to put up a good show but at the same time is disappointed to be on the losing side.

As the saying goes - 'It's never over, until it's over' was something we got to witness thereafter. Dhoni and Bhuvneshwar Kumar kept a calm head and countered through the turbulent tides. The latter in particular, was exceptional with his defense and aggression. He registered his maiden ODI fifty and recorded a 100-run stand for the 8th wicket which helped him bail his side out of an embarrassment. True to say that, the experiments failed miserably for India but they will take a leaf out of this extraordinary effort from their No. 9. Stay tuned as Roshan Abeysinghe is out there for presentation...

What a memorable victory for team India to take a 2-0 lead! Something that they will cherish for a very long time. Not many would believe it if you tell them, India started the chase in a stunning manner with Rohit and Dhawan motoring along rapidly. They raised a 109-opening stand in no time and it seemed like this match is heading towards one way. But, a young Akila Dananjaya changed the complexion of the game. He ran through the star-studded batting line-up and claimed a 6-fer in his first game against the Indians. From 109-0 to 131-7 was the collapse that the Indians had. They were literally on the mat to say the least.

A WIDE TO SETTLE IT! What a match this has turned out to be. Short and down the leg side, Dhoni looks to pull but isn't able to do so. Dickwella takes it by moving to his left. INDIA WIN BY 3 WICKETS WITH 16 BALLS TO SPARE. And the customary handshakes follow.
Scorers are level! Once again it's on the shorter side, Kumar tries to ramp it down but gets it off the toe end through backward point for a single.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Kumar tries to play the ramp shot but is undone by the bumper here.
Dhoni dances down the track and nudges it with soft hands towards square leg. Calls for two and gets to it in the end. Just 2 needed now. Akila finishes his spell with figures of - 10-0-54-6!
Short and outside off, cut hard but finds the man at point.
Around middle and leg, tucked around the corner for a single.

Maiden ODI fifty for Bhuvneshwar Kumar. What a knock this has been, especially overshadowing Dhoni in a run chase. He will remember this for a very long time. A raise of the bat from him and Kohli in the dressing room is all smiles. He cheers and Dhoni walks towards his partner to give a pat on the back. Well played, Bhuvi! Ball - Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
Flat and turning away from middle, slapped past point for a single.
Leg-break around middle, Dhoni hops back and pushes it towards cover.
Akila Dananjaya is back into the attack. India need just 8 to win from 24 balls. Can he pull off something special here?
Slants it away on a length outside off, flayed through backward point for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Punches through covers by Bhuvi and he's on 49 now.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Dhoni looks to punch it through the cover but gets an inside edge towards the right of the bowler for a single.
A bit fuller, angling away, driven through covers for a single.
Wide! Fernando bangs in a short ball outside off, Kumar lets it be. Too high and hence it's called as a wide.
Stays put and hits it through the line for a single.

FOUR! Just 14 needed now! Bhuvi has played a gem here. Chameera looks to fire a yorker but instead slips out a full toss on the pads. Bhuvneshwar shuffles a touch and makes the most of this bait. Helps it down to fine leg for another boundary.
Hits the deck hard and gets a good bounce. Bhuvneshwar arches back to evade it.
Gets across and flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, jammed down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Easily done! Sri Lanka have their hands on their heads. Back of a length delivery, it's a pacy delivery. Kumar gets inside the line and helps it fine down the leg side to pick up a boundary. Pressure straightaway on Sri Lanka.
Goes for the yorker first up but the line is wayward. Down the leg side and it's clipped towards long leg for a single.
After conceding 9 runs in the over, Akila Dananjaya has been taken off. Dushmantha Chameera comes on!
Fires in a wide yorker outside off, Dhoni crouches low and squeezes it out through backward point to keep strike. He wants to take it down to the wire, it seems.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched neatly through covers for a single.
Almost a yorker on middle and leg, but not that threatening as it was used to be by Malinga. It's helped down to backward square leg for a single.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Kumar hits it down to third man to bring Dhoni back on strike.
On middle and leg, nudged fine down the leg side for a single.
Fuller delivery from over the wicket, Dhoni pats it towards cover.
Fuller around off, wristed into the leg side. 9 runs from the over. Akila was brought back to cause some damage but this hasn't worked for the hosts.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is exceptional from Bhuvneshwar Kumar. He took the strike and has taken the main bowler on. Akila drops it short on middle, Kumar rocks back in a flash and dispatches it over mid-wicket for another boundary. 200 comes up for India!

FOUR! What a shot that is! Dananjaya drops it short and outside off, Kumar rocks back and punches it through extra cover. He times it well which beats Malinga in the deep. Lovely from Bhuvi! This is now his highest ODI score!
Gives it a loop outside off, Kumar drives it back to the bowler.
Dhoni comes down the track and seeing this Dananjaya drags his length back. The ball rolls off the splice of the bat towards point and Kumar is desperate to get to the other end.
Leg break around off, Dhoni dances down the track and pushes it towards cover.
The man of the moment, Akila Dananjaya comes back into the attack. He has got two overs left, can he scalp another one in it? It will also be interesting to see India's tactics against him.
Malinga tries to yorker but instead doles out a full toss on the pads. It's helped behind square on the leg side. Akila in the deep makes a diving stop to save a couple for his side.
Short ball around middle and leg, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Goes for the yorker, Dhoni is quick as he works it away on the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, Dhoni cuts it towards backward point. He wants the single but Kumar sends him back.
Slower short ball outside off, Dhoni doesn't play at it.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards cover.
Lasith Malinga has been brought on!
Darts it full around off, bunted back to the bowler. Siriwardana finishes his spell with figures of - 10-0-39-1!
Makes a bit of room and slaps it through covers to pick up a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! Tonk! He's nailed it. Floats it up outside off, Bhuvneshwar Kumar gets down on one knee and nails to slog sweep. Gets a good chunk of wood behind it as it sails over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Kumar dances down the track, gets a fuller ball, it's driven towards cover. Seems like Bhuvi is running out of patience.
Comes forward and keeps it out gently.
50-run stand is up between Dhoni and Kumar! What a vital stand it has been but the game is far from over yet and they need to keep their concentration. India need 50 runs off 60 balls now!
Good shot! Short of a length delivery outside off, Bhuvi rides the bounce and steers it down to third man to keep strike.
Comedy of errors! The umpire called it an over but there was still a ball remaining. Umpire Reiffel realised it later and called the Fernando back, who was halfway towards the boundary.
Shortish and outside off, Kumar looks play the upper cut but fails to get any wood on it.
Fuller outside off, Bhuvi looks to drive it away from the body but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Length delivery, served outside off, Dhoni crunches it through covers and takes the single.
Short and angling away, Kumar slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A bit fuller and angling away, driven with an open face to backward point.
Wide! Short of a length delivery, from over the wicket, too high and it's rightly called as a wide.
Stays back and knocks it down to long on to keep strike.
A bit flat and served outside off, Kumar punches it towards the cover fielder.
Dhoni takes a stride forward and eases it down to long off for one.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Goes back and defends it towards cover.

NOT OUT! Sri Lanka waste their review! Moment of luck riding India's way at the moment? Siriwardana lands it around leg, Kumar gets down to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal from Milinda to which the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka take the review and replays shows it was in line but would have gone on to clip the leg pole. So, the umpire's call stays.
Sri Lanka have taken the review against an LBW decision given not out against Bhuvneshwar Kumar. It seems to be sliding down. Let's see...
Fuller and outside off, driven along the ground through covers for a single. 57 needed from 72 balls.
Fuller delivery outside off, pushed towards cover off the front foot.
Drops it short on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

Lucky, MS! That's so unfortunate for Sri Lanka. Length delivery on middle, Dhoni gets across to tuck it away but the ball goes off the pads and rolls back on the stumps. It hits its base, but much to Dhoni's delight the bails don't come off. They stay as it is. The Lankans can't believe it and so can't we!
Gets it wide of the man at backward point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side where the fielder leaps to collect it.
Flattish delivery outside off, it stays really low. Dhoni was standing on the leg stump so had to crouch and jams it out successfully.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off. One run added to the total.
Tossed up outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Drops it short around middle, tucked towards fine leg.
Comes down the track and blocks it out.
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Slightly short and outside off, Kumar gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single. First run for Bhuvi after 17 balls, this.
A bit short and outside off, Kumar looks to slash but misses it.
Angles it away on a length and outside off, MS Dhoni dabs it away down to third man for a single.
Wide! Sprays it too wide outside off to make Dhoni go at it.
Another length delivery outside of, punched towards Danushka again who stops with a dive to his right.
Good stop! Length delivery outside off, Dhoni punches it towards backward point where Gunathilaka dives to his right to stop it. Seems to have landed on the right shoulder and is down in some pain.
Wide! Slants it wide across the batsman, MS lets it be this time.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhoni tries reaching out to that one but fails to do so.
Vishwa Fernando comes back into the attack. 67 runs needed from 90 balls.
A bit slower through the air around middle, worked towards the man at mid-wicket.
Quicker one around off, defended into the ground.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
A bit short and outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Fuller ball around middle and leg, Kumar looks to sweep but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side.
Goes back and tucks it around the corner for a single.
Milinda Siriwardana is back on. Can he provide with the breakthrough?
A bit short outside off, Bhuvi defends it from within the crease.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards the cover region off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Kumar ducks to evade it.
Fuller in the pads, MS Dhoni flicks it through mid-wicket. Wants the double but won't get it.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhoni shoulders his arms to it.
Good ball! Short and angling in, all Kumar could do was to move away from the line.
Wide! Third wide of the over! It's been a long over. Once again hits the deck hard does Malinga but the angle is taking the ball down the leg side. More work for Dickwella behind the stumps.
Short of a length delivery on middle, defended nicely from within the crease.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball, down the leg side. Kumar lets it be.
Bhuvi has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Nice delivery, fuller in length outside off, Kumar looks to defend it off the front foot but is beaten by the lack of bounce.
Short and angling down leg, Dhoni pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Dhoni moves inside the line to let it be.
Fuller and veering on the pads, Dhoni clips it behind square on the leg side for a comfortable couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Bhuvi defends it off the back foot.
Nasty bouncer that! Short and angling into the body, Kumar does well to evade the fire line.

Short and down the leg side, Kumar looks to glance it down to fine leg. It goes off something to the keeper who takes it and starts to appeal. The bowler then joins in too but the umpire shakes his head. Upul Tharanga wants to review it but then for some reason doesn't opt for it.
Fuller delivery on middle, pushed towards mid on for a single.
Shortish outside off, Dhoni rocks back and pulls it fiercely through backward square leg. The man in the deep comes across to his right and makes a lovely stop to prevent a boundary. Two runs taken.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhoni defends it off the front foot towards cover.

Drinks break! After the first drinks break, we saw Sri Lanka gather momentum and break the backbone of Indian batting. Will this break also see a change in the momentum for the visitors? INDIA NEED 78 OFF 114 BALLS WITH JUST 3 WICKETS IN HAND!
Short and down the leg side, Dhoni mistimes his pull to fine leg for a single.
Banged in short, Dhoni lets it sail through to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery, angling down, nudged behind square leg for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Straighter one, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.
Lasith Malinga replaces Dananjaya!
Banged in short, Kumar sways out of its way.
Full and tailing into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
A leg slip comes in place.
Outside off, left alone.
Brave leave! On a good length outside off, Kumar gets across and decided to leave it in the end. The ball just whizzes past the off pole.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and angling in, defended with the angle to mid on.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on. A break for Siriwardana!
Tossed up on middle and leg, Kumar leans ahead and blocks it down the track.
Cut off the back foot to deep cover-point for a single.
Spinning in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Leg spinner around off, Kumar looks to play it against the spin but gets an outside edge which runs through behind square on the off side. Malinga runs after it and saves a run for his team.
Dhoni dances down and knocks it to long off for a single.
Wide outside off, tapped to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Kumar leans ahead and blocks it with ease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Driven through mid on for a single.
Flat delivery outside off, placed to deep cover for a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Spinning away from Kumar. He fails to pick it and gets beaten.
Tossed up around off, Kumar prods forward to defend.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Straighter one outside off, Kumar fails to put the bat to the ball and gets beaten.
Worked off the inner half on the leg side for a single.
Another front foot defence presented by Bhuvi!
Bhuvneshwar covers his stumps and defends it.
Kumar prods ahead and blocks it.
Leg bye! Sliding down leg, Dhoni looks to shovel it away but misses. The ball trickles off the thigh pad to short fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
FOUR! A much-needed one! Dhoni dances down the track and whips it wide of mid on for a boundary. That will release the pressure a touch!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Kumar is alert, watches the ball till the last moment and the blocks it away.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is the new batsman. A slip, a short leg and a backward short leg in place.

OUT! 6-wicket haul for Dananjaya! Drifts it in from outside off. Patel leans ahead to defend but his bat is nowhere near the ball. He is beaten and gets pinged on the front pad. Akila starts running in celebration and then appeals ala Philander. The umpire obliges by raising his finger. India have lost the way from 109/0 to 131/7! What an interesting span of play we have witnessed, all thanks to the leggie Dananjaya.

Shout for a catch! Spinning down leg, Patel prods ahead to defend it but misses and the ball lobs off the pads to leg slip. The players start appealing but the umpire isn't interested. The replays show that it came straight off the pads.
Patel prods ahead and blocks it away.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Googly around off, punched to covers.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Eased down to long on for a single.
Spinning in, flicked with the spin on the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot for a single.
Pushed to covers off the front foot.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Worked behind square on the leg side for a brace.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Dabbed to point.
Axar Patel walks out to bat.

OUT! 5-fer for Akila Dananjaya! What a match he is having! It's his first game against India and he has rocked them hard. Bowls it slower through the air, inviting Pandya ahead. He dances down but the flight and googly does him in. Dickwella behind the stumps gathers the ball and has enough time to take the bails off. Hardik can't get back in his crease and now has to walk back dejected. 5 wickets in span of 13 balls from the leggie! He has just turned the game around. Unbelievable stuff, this!
Milked down to long off for a single.
Dhoni dances down and drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Dhoni dances down and eases it down to long off for a single.
Sliding into the batsman, Dhoni fails to put bat to it and gets hit on the pads.
Served around leg, spinning away, turned on the leg side.
Dhoni prods forward and blocks it on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

NOT OUT! Pandya is well in! Coming back to the ball, Hardik dances down the ground and pushed down the ground on the leg side. Akila rushes to his right, stops the ball and hurls a throw back to the keeper. Dickwella behind the stumps collects the ball and knocks off the stumps. The players appeal and the square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replay shows that Lokesh is well in.
A run out appeal against Hardik Pandya is referred upstairs...
Hardik Pandya walks in next. Remember, he's not fit but has come out as his side is in immense pressure.

OUT! What is going on here? Third wrong 'un and third bowled of the over! Flighted around off, spinning in, keeps a touch low as well. That's enough to sneak through the gap between Rahul's bat and pad and hit the stumps. He has turned the game upside down in a single over. Half the Indian side is back in the hut.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
MS Dhoni strides out to bat. India need a calm persona like him in the middle currently.

OUT! Timber! Big, big wicket this! Once again it's the wrong 'un which does the trick for Akila. Tossed up fuller around off, spinning in, Kohli looks to flick it across the line but misses it completely and then sees the woodwork being rattled. Kohli has to walk back with a disappointed face. Dananjaya is pumped up and why won't he be? It's his third wicket of the match and that too of the Indian skipper. India are in trouble for the first time in the match. Can Lanka make the most of this?
FOUR! A short delivery, keeps low and spins in. Kohli rocks back and pulls it with disdain through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Here comes Virat Kohli. He wanted to do some experiments and that is why he is coming down the order.

OUT! Wrong one does the trick for Dananjaya! Tossed up around off, Jadhav stays back to defend but the ball spins in sharply, beating him and knocks off the middle stump. Kedar is completely outfoxed with this wrong 'un and has to pay the price. He walks away, admiring the delivery. The experiment of promoting Jadhav up the order has failed.
Rahul prods forward and blocks it.
In the air... but in no man's land! Served outside off, spinning away, sliced over covers. 'Catch it' is the call from the fielders but it falls short of sweeper cover. A single is taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
As expected Kedar Jadhav walks in next!

OUT! Mathews has hung on to an absolute stunner! Slower through the air around leg, Dhawan kneels down to sweep but gets it off the toe end in the air behind square on the leg side. The ex-Lankan skipper at short fine leg, runs to his right and dives full stretch to grab the catch. That's a beauty of a catch and Dhawan misses out on his half century. Had he got that, it would have been a record 7 consecutive 50-plus scores against Sri Lanka! Both the openers are back in the dressing room!
Driven through covers for a single.
Tossed up around leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Another surprise as Jadhav has been padded up and Kohli hasn't!
Short delivery, pulled to mid on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shout for lbw! Spinning down leg, Rahul prods forward to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down as it's spinning way down leg.
KL Rahul is the new man in. He walks ahead of his skipper. Kohli had mentioned about experiments being made today and here's one for you all.

OUT! Dananjaya draws first blood! Rohit fails to convert his start into a big one! Tossed up around middle and leg, spinning away. Sharma kneels down and looks to sweep but misses and gets pinged on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire straightaway raises his dreaded finger. After a long discussion with Dhawan, Rohit goes for the review. The Ultra Edge confirms no involvement of the bat and Hawk Eye shows three reds. The Indian opener has to walk back.
Rohit Sharma has been adjudged lbw! However, he has taken the review! Looks plumb though.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! Into the stands! Seeing the mid on fielder up in the circle, Dhawan decided to go after the bowler. He danced down the track and clobbered it over long on for a maximum. What a start to the over!
FOUR! Sharma has found the gap to perfection! Full and sliding in, Rohit gets down on one knee and sweeps it off the meat through long leg for a boundary.
Dhawan dances down and tonks it to long on for a single.
Rohit Sharma reaches to his 32nd ODI fifty. In fact, this is his fastest fifty in the ODIs. Quite a feat that. This is also Rohit Sharma's 1st 50+ score in Sri Lanka in last 12 ODI innings.
Tossed up around middle, Sharma milks down to long on for a single.
Wide! Sliding down leg, Sharma looks to sweep it away but misses. Wide is signalled.
Served around off, spinning away, driven down the track through mid off. Siriwardana goes after it but fails to field it.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Milinda Sirawardana will operate from the other end, replacing Chameera.
Pushed back to the bowler from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Off-break on the shorter side outside off, cracked through cover-point for a couple.
Slanting into the batsman, Sharma goes back to defend but misses and gets hit near the box.
Sliding down leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.

In the air... but just over! That could have had Dhawan's heart in his mouth. Slower through the air around middle and leg, Dhawan kneels down to paddle sweep but gets a top edge which flies over the keeper. Mathews from first slip sprints after it but the ball falls away from him and then trickles away a touch. Till that time, Dhawan collects a brace.
Drinks break!
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.

FOUR! Short and is punished! Chameera has been guilty of being too short regularly. He once again drops it shorter around leg and Dhawan rocks back to pull it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Dushmantha has been taken to cleaners today.
Full around off, angling in sharply. Driven off the inner half to mid on.
Once again Chameera pitches on the shorter side. Sharma stays back and pulls it over backward square leg for a single. He turns around for a second but it's not there to be taken.
Short and angling into the batsman, helped to long leg with a controlled pull for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Rohit rides the bounce and punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary to end the over! Served slower through the air on middle and off. Dhawan dances down and with a superb wrist work flicks it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Shikhar dances down the track and blocks it.
Flighted around middle, Dhawan is very watchful and blocks it.
Sharma prods forward and dabs it in front of square on the off side for a single. There's a shy at the bowler's end but hits Sharma instead.
Eased down to long off for a single.
Straighter one around off, punched to covers.
Akila Dananjaya comes on to roll his arm.
Full outside off, pushed effortlessly through covers for a single.
Around leg, tickled fine down the leg side for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! That's been cracked away! Length delivery, angling away, Dhawan dances down and cuts it hard into the ground. It bounces over the leaping Mendis at point and races to the fence behind.
Short delivery, angling away, chopped to point.
Full outside off, dabbed to covers.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Now, from 11-38 overs, a maximum of 4 fielders can stay outside the circle.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Defended with the angle to mid-wicket.
Wide! Sprays it outside leg, Dhawan tries flicking it down but misses. A wide is signalled.
On a length around middle and off, Dhawan stays back and blocks it off the middle.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point for a single.

SIX! Back-to-back biggies! Short and wide outside off, Sharma flashes and flashes hard at it. Gets it off the outer half and the ball sails flat over third man for half a dozen. This spoils Chameera's first over. 12 runs off it.

SIX! Innovation at its best! Good length delivery outside off, angling in, Rohit gets across and kneels down. Gets underneath the ball and scoops it high over fine leg. Such a great shot and he gets the deserved result in a maximum. The hand-eye co-ordination had to be spot on and it was from Sharma.
Another back of a length delivery around off, Sharma gets on the top of the bounce and taps it to covers.
Back of a length delivery around off, Sharma gets on his toes and blocks it away.

In the air for a moment but well short of the fielder! Back of a length delivery, angling in. Sharma goes for the pull but he is late into the shot. Mistimes it badly and the ball falls short of Malinga at mid on. The Indian opener needs to be really careful here!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Dushmantha Chameera comes into the attack now.
Full around off, carved to covers.
Punched off the back foot to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Stand tall and deliver! Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma rides the bounce and punches it solidly through cover-point for a boundary. India are cruising through at the moment.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish around off, driven to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Well done, Dhawan! He picked up the slower one early. Waited for the in-dipping low full toss on the pads and then just flicked it away through square leg for a boundary.
Slanting away from the southpaw, chopped to point.
Angling into the batsman, worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Smashed it! Full outside off, Sharma's eyes lit up seeing that. He decides to go after it and does so with a handsome lofted drive over wide mid off for a boundary. He is just growing into the game.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Banged in short! Sharma ducks under it to let it sail through to the keeper.
Good length delivery around off, punched crunchly through point. Kapugedera there, dives to his left but fails to stop it cleanly. The ball gets parried away and a single is taken.
Length delivery, angling away, Dhawan dances down and cuts it into the ground towards point.
Length delivery around off, Dhawan tries to run it down to third man but ends up chopping it beside the wicket behind square on the off side.
Full on middle, pushed gently to mid off.
Angelo Mathews comes on to bowl.
Outside off, left alone.
Another play and a miss by Sharma! On a length outside off, moves away a shade. Rohit goes after it but gets beaten.
On the pads, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Angling into the right-hander, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Superb placement! Full and wide outside off. Dhawan bends his knees and just guides it through backward point for a boundary. Both the batsmen have looked good so far.
8000 International runs for Rohit Sharma! 14th Indian to achieve this feat!

FOUR! Another poor line from Fernando. He sprays it onto the pads. Rohit stays in the crease and flicks it square of the wicket on the leg side for a boundary. Gets to his 8000 international runs with that. He has been such an important player for the Men in Blue in recent times.
Slanting away from Sharma, he looks to drive it through covers but gets an outside edge which rolls towards the keeper.
Full outside off, driven through covers. Siriwardana makes a hash of an easy stop and concedes a single.
FOUR! Length delivery, angling in, tucked away nicely through backward square leg for a boundary.
Full outside off, Dhawan dances down and looks to hoick it over the infield on the off side but gets it off the toe end towards covers.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Very full and tailing into the batsman. Sharma looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge onto the boots. The Lankan players see their stifled appeal turned down.
Straying on the pads again, clipped through square leg for a brace.

SIX! Just the flick of the wrists! That's a great pick-up shot from Rohit Sharma. He pounces on the fuller length delivery on middle and leg with an elegant flick over mid-wicket. It travels flat and straight into the stands there. This will get him going!
Defended off the front foot to mid on.
Wide! Another one! The Lankan bowlers have been very poor with the lines to start with. Once again it's sprayed down the leg side for 4th wide already.
Length delivery, angling into the pads. Rohit looks to work it across the line but misses and gets rapped on the pads. No appeal there as it was going down leg.
Good length delivery around off, defended neatly.
Wide! Down the leg side again. Sharma once again tries to flick it away and sees the umpire spread his arms to signal wide.
Back of a length delivery around off, blocked away.
Fuller on the boots, driven to mid on.
Good length delivery around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around leg, worked behind square on the leg side. The fielder in the deep puts in a diving effort and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Second slip comes in for Dhawan.
Full and wide outside off, Sharma strides ahead, looks to drive it away from the body but gets it off the outer half towards third man. A single is taken.
Wide! Fernando looks to angle it away from Sharma but it's wayward. A leave from the batsman and a wide is signalled.
VISHWA FERNANDO to operate with the second new ball. Just a slip in place for him.
Very full and tailing in towards the pads. Dhawan looks to flick it but gets an inside edge onto the boots and back to the bowler.
Length delivery, angling in, tucked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Angling into the batsman, played with the angle to mid on.
On a length around off, Rohit stays back and blocks it away.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side this time. Sharma fails to flick it away and gets a wide.
FOUR! That made a solid sound! Good length delivery around off, Sharma stands tall and punches it through covers. That made a superb connection and it just raced away to the fence!

Beautiful delivery! A perfect outswinger, a touch fuller than a length in the corridor of uncertainty. Sharma feels for it but the ball shaping away beats him. Malinga is unlucky not to get a nick there.

We are back for the chase. For this innings - Two bowlers can bowl a maximum of 10 overs while three bowlers can bowl a maximum of 9 overs. Powerplay 1 will be from 1-10, Powerplay 2 will be from 11-38 and the final Powerplay will be from 39-47. The in-form, SHIKHAR DHAWAN and ROHIT SHARMA will open with LASITH MALINGA to operate with the first new ball. A couple of slips in place for him. Here we go...
